game.title: Sunset Overdrive
game.blurb: Open-world third-person shooter of grinding, bouncing and wild guns in Sunset City, from Insomniac Games, released 2014-10-28 (RAWG also lists Blind Squirrel Games). RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Surviving the first nights, Buck, the glider crash, the Troop, the Excalamune and the fight against Fizzco.

chapters.title: The Mooil Rig
chapters.summary: A trip to the Mooil Rig, the boat defence and the sea monster.

chapters.title: The Factory and the Weapon Pitch
chapters.summary: Sneaking into a factory, robot costumes, rescuing Fiona and Lou, and designing new weapons.

chapters.title: Factions and Side Quests
chapters.summary: Quests from each Faction, Ignatius's RPG, Fargarthia, Floyd's Amps, the comic book collector and fort upgrades.

chapters.title: Collectibles Around Sunset City
chapters.summary: Smartphones, sightseeing spots, cameras, satellites, billboards, shoes, signs, balloons, toilet paper, drawings and fashion.

chapters.title: Challenges and Replays
chapters.summary: Challenge medals and high scores, and replaying missions under par.

chapters.title: Combat, Style and Traversal
chapters.summary: Massacring OD, style kills, traps, upgrading guns, Amps, Badges and Overdrives.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Sunset Overdrive". sunsetoverdrive.fandom.com answers the API, but the game page links to only 10 articles (for example "Sunset City", "Fizzco", "Chaos Squad"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Sunflower" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 847370 as "Sunset Overdrive". None of the 80 Steam achievements is hidden. Achievements 61 to 65 (Mooil Rig, boat, sea monster) and 66 to 74 (factory, Fiona and Lou, Brandon, weapon design) form two later blocks in the schema with lower unlock rates; they may be add-on stories, but no achievement names one, so the chapters are named after the places. "Big Tobacco" and "Big Break" were placed by their spot in those blocks. RAWG lists a playtime of only 4 hours, which looks low.
